question: How do I start a new Chulapa site on GitHub Pages?
expected: Recommend chulapa-101 as a personal blog template; create repository, enable Settings > Pages > GitHub Actions, set title/description/author/repository/url and commit to main or master. Workflow supplies base path; no local install or personal token required. Cite /docs/00-start directly; preserve settings and change only the home heading in index.html; edit the article in an existing _posts/ file and check both publicly.

result.answer:
To start a new Chulapa site on GitHub Pages, use the Chulapa 101 template. Follow these steps:

1.  **Generate the site**: Use the template at [https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101/generate](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101/generate).
2.  **Configure GitHub Pages**: Go to your repository **Settings > Pages** and ensure **GitHub Actions** is selected as the source.
3.  **Configure site details**: Edit `_config.yml` to set your `title`, `description`, `author`, `repository`, and `url`.
4.  **Customize content**: 
    *   Edit `index.html` for your home page title.
    *   Add posts to the `_posts/` directory using the format `YYYY-MM-DD-title.md`.
5.  **Publish**: Commit your changes to your publishing branch (e.g., `main` or `master`) and wait for the GitHub Actions workflow to succeed.

Verify your site is live by checking the URL provided in **Settings > Pages**.

Sources:
* [Installation guide](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/01-install)
* [Starting a site](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/00-start)
